Dimaag jo bhi soch sakta hai aur jismein vishwas kar sakta hai, use haasil kar sakta hai.
"Future depend karta hai—today tum kya karte."
"Ready ho ya na ho, tum start karoge."
"Failure to failure se aage badhna—enthusiasm nahi khona."
"Sabse zyada matter: fire se kaise walk karte."
Success haar se haar tak ka safar hai bina utsaah khoye.
"Winner woh jo ek aur dafa uthta."
"Best investment: khud me."
"Thoughts words ban jaate."
